scientific.integrity: The published AdaPlus recurrence is specialized directly to a deterministic scalar strongly convex quadratic. The first source update is evaluated exactly, while the limiting local dynamics are obtained by linearizing the parameter, first-moment, and second-moment states and applying the quadratic Jury criterion.
limitations: Published AdaPlus Algorithm 1 with zero weight decay.
Deterministic scalar strongly convex quadratic and constant hyperparameters.
The startup statement is a first-step objective result.
The tail statement is a limiting local spectral result, not a global convergence theorem.
Software variants with different epsilon placement are outside scope.

title: AdaPlus has a sharp startup–tail curvature gap on quadratics
